--- PROPOSAL 1 (PRIMARY, and the one I would actually stake) ---
ID: magnitude.terminal_impact_coefficient_carry
STATUS: PROPOSED. This is a MAGNITUDE lever. It is SIGN-FREE by construction and must never be used as a sign justification.
TRIGGER: any next-session magnitude sizing where the prior session's phase table is served.
READ: define k3 = |prior session ph3 price change| / |prior session ph3 signed flow|, the tape's marginal price impact per unit of aggressor imbalance at the session's terminal phase. Require |ph3 flow| >= 500 lots so the ratio is measured on real flow rather than noise. k3 CARRIES ACROSS THE OVERNIGHT SEAM. It is the market's current exchange rate between flow and price, and it is a state, not a forecast.
CALL: when k3_prev <= 0.05 (the NUMB class), expect a SMALL next-day move: |day move| <= ~200 USD. Point estimate = (session signed flow) x k3_prev. Say nothing about sign.
EVIDENCE, per instance, never pooled as the conclusion. Numb instances across the staged groups, n=6 spanning g20 and g23: g20 0528->0529 (k3 0.043, f3 3762) next -160; g20 0601->0602 (k3 0.022, f3 1830) next -70; g20 0604->0605 (k3 0.032, f3 2816) next -1350; g23 0713->0714 (k3 0.026, f3 1162) next +200 [MY DAY]; g23 0714->0715 (k3 0.018, f3 1128) next -50; g23 0715->0716 (k3 0.036, f3 3342) next -20. Five of six land at or under 200 USD; median 115.
CALIBRATION AGAINST BASE RATE (this is what makes it a claim rather than an observation): across all 40 staged sessions in g20-g23 the median |day net| is 535 and only 12 of 40 days (30 percent) come in at or under 200. The numb limb hits 5 of 6 (83 percent). The lift is real and it is large.
THE ONE FAILURE, named and not explained away: g20 0604->0605 delivered -1350. I decline to invent a scope condition to rescue it - the obvious candidate (exclude numb phases that terminate a large absorption day, 0604 being +1140 on -5662 of flow) would also exclude g20 0528, which is a hit. The honest statement is 5 of 6 with one live counterexample, and the counterexample is the reason the rule is a lever and not a gate.
CONVERSE LIMB, weaker, n=2 spanning two groups: k3_prev >= 0.50 on f3 >= 500 gives g22 0623->0624 (+790) and g23 0708->0709 (-2050). Both large. Suggestive of a two-sided coefficient reading; not claimable at n=2.
WHAT IT DOES NOT CLAIM: nothing about direction. The six numb instances split five down and one up, and the one up is mine - a specialist claiming sign off his own single positive instance would be doing exactly what the walk's block-lean misses did.
SCOPE: NG, injection/summer era as measured (g20 late May-early June, g23 July). Requires the served phase table. HDD-season behaviour unmeasured.
BLIND-USABILITY - the reason this matters: k3_prev is computed entirely from the PRIOR session's phase table, which is pre-cutoff information. This is not a refine-only quantity. It can go into the blind's hands directly, and that is the point of proposing it.
FALSIFIER: a seam where k3_prev <= 0.05 on f3 >= 500 and the next session moves >= 700 USD absent an exogenous catalyst. A second instance of the 0605 class demotes this to a catalyst-conditional rule.
FORWARD TEST: G24+.

--- PROPOSAL 3 (upgrade of an existing PROPOSED play) ---
ID: handoff.residual_tilt_field - GENERALIZE the trigger and REPLACE the justification.
CURRENT FORM: on program days (index roll, BCOM), do not consume the D-1 raw aggregate signed flow as a directional tilt; decontaminate by cohort. n=2, and both instances were executed as a declared PROXY because tape_conditions carries no cohort decomposition.

ID: calendar.index_roll_window_is_a_container_not_a_cause
STATUS: PROPOSED, n=1 block executed as a causal test (g23) - deliberately NOT claimed at n=2, because the honest instance count is one and the walk has been burned by rules that generalized off a single block.

A roll-window sum that appears to 'explain' a block is an arithmetic coincidence of containment unless the moves inside it are themselves flow-driven at a measured coefficient.

The mechanism is the program. 0715 is BCOM roll day 5 of 5: a long-index roll SELLS the front leg, and a seller working a large resting order all day is exactly a book that prints aggressor-BUY on every lift while never letting price go bid. (1) THERE WAS NO COLLISION. flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt's own expiry_day_extension_s110 text contains an explicit CONSEQUENCE GUARD which names price_free_absorption_proxy as one of the big-print instruments that loses authority on program days. The precedence is written into the brain. My blind declared a collision between a rule and its own stated subordinate. That is an error of reading, not a defect in the brain, and I withdraw the declaration.
(2) THE GUARD IS CONFIRMED ON MY DAY, NOT FALSIFIED - and my day is the instance it should have been applied to. Because 0715 is in_bcom_roll day 5, the guard's trigger fires on 0715 ITSELF, which my blind never noticed. On that day the aggressor tilt was +6,326 BUY, the largest of the block, and the day sign was NEGATIVE - the inversion, in the play's own vocabulary, with ph_absorb TRUE on the final phase. Its fingerprint matches the G21 0608 instance the play was built from to within ten units: G21 0608 ph2 +2,858 of buy against -120 of price; G23 0715 ph2 +2,868 of buy against +40. The play now has n=2 spanning G21 and G23 on the resting/inverted form.
The 0714 instance, taken separately, is a PARTIAL falsifier that does NOT discharge. The play's falsifier requires two limbs: a scheduled-program session where the tilt matches the day sign AND the program is demonstrably the dominant participant. Limb one fires - 0714 tilt +3,747 buy, day +200 up. Limb two is not demonstrable in the committed slice, and what evidence exists points the other way: 0714 was the block's THINNEST full session at 29,224 trades against a block median near 40,000, which is not what a dominant program looks like. Undemonstrated, so it does not discharge. I decline to bank a falsification I cannot show.
(3) THE PROXY IS NOT REFUTED EITHER - IT IS MIS-SCALED, and that supersedes both branches of the collision. Applied 0714 -> 0715 it read big_print_b_share 0.553 against its fitted bar of 0.547, declared 'absorber gone, accumulation confirmed', and pointed UP one session before the block's largest absorption event. But the reading cleared the bar by 0.006. Measured across all nine fires in g20-g23 the proxy's information sits in the TAILS and 0.547 is inside the noise: readings at or below 0.47 go 3 for 3 (g20 0602 bp 0.436 -> -80; g22 0625 bp 0.466 -> -60; g23 0710 bp 0.454 -> -660, all non-positive); the one decisive clear goes 1 for 1 (g20 0603 bp 0.585 -> +750); and the five readings between 0.47 and 0.58 run +70, +230, -520, -60, -20 - two up, three down, no ordering at all. My day's 0.553 is in that no-call band. So the correct handling of 0714's big-print channel was neither 'absorber gone' nor 'authority stripped by the calendar' - it was NO CALL, on the reading's own magnitude, and that would have been available blind.
WHICH FALSIFIER DISCHARGES: none of the three cleanly, and I will say so rather than force one. What discharges is a SCOPE REPAIR on the proxy (raise the bars, open a no-call band - see proposal_contribution item 1) plus a CONFIRMATION for the guard on 0715. The program/clean split adds a second, confounded reading which I record because it cuts the other way and I cannot separate the two at n=9: the proxy's clean-input fires go 4 of 5 and its program-input fires go 1 of 4, exactly what the consequence guard predicts. Two of those four program fires ARE the marginal clears, so extremity and contamination are collinear here. Both readings are on the table; neither is established.

GENERAL-MECHANISM CONTRIBUTIONS (proposal text only, no brain edit). Each carries per-event instances, counterexamples, scope, n, and a falsifier. Nothing here is offered as established.

(1) PRICE_FREE_ABSORPTION_PROXY - SCOPE REPAIR, NOT REFUTATION. n=9 fires spanning G20, G21, G22, G23.
CLAIM: the big-print channel carries information only in its TAILS, and the fitted 0.547 bar sits inside the noise. Per event, never pooled as the conclusion - readings at or below 0.47 under positive aggregate flow: G20 0602 bp 0.436 -> -80; G22 0625 bp 0.466 -> -60; G23 0710 bp 0.454 -> -660. Three of three non-positive, spanning three groups. The one decisive clear above the bar: G20 0603 bp 0.585 -> +750, one of one. The five readings in between: G21 0609 bp 0.498 -> +70; G22 0626 bp 0.499 -> +230; G23 0708 bp 0.535 -> -520; G23 0715 bp 0.553 -> -60; G23 0716 bp 0.555 -> -20. Two up, three down, no ordering.
PROPOSED FORM: absorber PRESENT at bp <= 0.47 (keep, n=3 spanning three groups); absorber GONE at bp >= 0.58 (n=1, insufficient, hold as a candidate); NO CALL in 0.47 < bp < 0.58.
WHY THE ASYMMETRY IS PRINCIPLED and not curve-fitting: 'big prints still selling under a buying count tape' is a DIRECT observation of a resting seller. 'Big prints flipping buy' is only the ABSENCE of that observation, and absence is not evidence the seller left - it is equally evidence the seller stopped needing to print. G23 0715 is that argument's sharpest instance: 0714's big prints flipped buy at 0.553 and the very next session produced the block's largest absorption event, +6,326 of net buy for -60. The absorber had never gone anywhere.
CONFOUND I CANNOT SEPARATE AND WILL NOT HIDE: split by program contamination instead of by extremity, the proxy's clean-input fires go 4 of 5 and its program-input fires go 1 of 4 - exactly what resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt's consequence guard predicts. Two of the four program fires ARE the marginal clears, so the two explanations are collinear at n=9. Both are on the table; neither is established. RESOLVING MEASUREMENT: find a fire with a marginal reading (0.50-0.56) on a CLEAN D-1, or a decisive reading (<=0.47 or >=0.58) on a PROGRAM D-1. Neither exists in g20-g23.
FALSIFIER: a bp <= 0.47 fire under positive aggregate flow that delivers a materially positive day, or a run of no-call-band readings that orders correctly.

(2) INDEX-ROLL WINDOW BLOCK LEAN - CORRECTED CALENDAR AND A CORRECTED MECHANISM. n=2 spanning G21 and G23, with G22 as a clean silent control.
CALENDAR CORRECTION FIRST, because it revises the tables already written into g23's 0708 refine file: the window must be the UNION of in_gsci_roll, in_bcom_roll and in_bcom_hedge_roll, not the GSCI leg alone. The legs are offset - in G23, GSCI runs 0708-0714 and BCOM runs 0709-0715 - so 20260715 is IN the window (bcom_roll_day_n 5) and was previously counted out of it. Corrected per event: G23 in-window 0708 -520, 0709 -2,050, 0710 -660, 0713 -620, 0714 +200, 0715 -60 = -3,710 over six sessions; G23 out 0706 +100, 0707 +160, 0716 -20, 0717 +180 = +420 over four. G21 in-window 0608 -890, 0609 +70, 0610 +490, 0611 -1,080, 0612 +620 = -790 over five; G21 out 0615 +160, 0616 +970, 0617 -970, 0618 +520, 0619 -110 = +570 over five. G22 has no program window on any of the three flags and sums +470 over ten. Out-of-window day-means: +105 (G23), +114 (G21), +47 (G22) - positive in all three.
MECHANISM CORRECTION, which is what my day contributes: the window does not SELL, it CAPS. On 0715, the window's final session, aggressors bought the block's largest tilt (+6,326 net across 72,162 lots) and the day closed -60. The measurable is the transfer function - usd of day-move per unit of net aggressor flow - and it collapses inside the window: 0714 0.053, 0715 0.009, 0716 0.018 (the three lowest of the block, being the last two program sessions plus the digestion day) against 0.158 and 0.092 on the clean pre-window sessions 0706 and 0707. This is why a calendar-spread trade with no business moving the outright can still own a block: it does not push price down, it removes the market's ability to go UP, and a bearish catalyst arriving inside the window (0709, alone 55 percent of G23's window decline) then runs undefended.
SCOPE, tight: a WINDOW-SUM / block-lean statement, never a per-day sign rule. Named counterexamples: G23 0714 +200 on roll day 4, G21 0610 +490, G21 0612 +620.
FALSIFIER: a staged block whose union-window sums POSITIVE while its non-window remainder sums negative; or a window whose transfer function does NOT compress relative to its own block's clean days.
REQUIRED MEASUREMENT before promotion: stage the next-month leg (NGU26 here) so roll flow can be separated from outright liquidation. Until then the mechanism is inferred from the outright's transfer function alone.

(3) THE BURN GATE IS A FLOW INSTRUMENT, NOT A PRICE INSTRUMENT - proposed as a MEASUREMENT TO RUN, not as a play to fire. n=1 clean instance; deliberately under-claimed.
CLAIM: est_gas_burn_bcfd and the CDD ladder describe how much gas gets bought; they say nothing about whether that buying clears. Re-aim the gate at the ORDER FLOW and stop asking it for price.
THE ONE CLEAN INSTANCE is G23 0715, and it is clean because both readings are block extremes on the same day: block-max burn 47.2, block-min solar, wind off, every forward run-delta warm - and the block-max aggressor buy flow, +6,326, 69 percent above the next-largest. The demand signal converted into flow exactly as the gate says it should. It then failed at the price stage against a scheduled roll seller, and the day printed -60.
WHY I AM NOT PROPOSING THIS AS A RULE: I have one instance, and the block's burn and flow ranks elsewhere do not obviously line up (0717 carries the highest burn of all, 51.0, on a +1,333 tilt). The proposal is to MEASURE rank(burn) against rank(session_signed_flow) across staged groups before anyone writes a rule, and to stop scoring the gate against price in the meantime.
WHAT IS ESTABLISHED, separately and firmly: the gate's PRICE claim is refuted. Its own falsifier ('a burn-confirmed CDD add that fails to deliver, in G23+') discharges on G23 0715 with every limb at its most favourable reading. Pre-graft, and inside the play's own evidence list, G22 0624 and 0625 carry the IDENTICAL served burn of 39.3 with 0625 on lower wind, and delivered +800 and -60 on consecutive sessions. The play cites 0624 and is silent on its twin.

(4) TWO NEGATIVES, reported so nobody rebuilds them.
(4a) THE AGGRESSOR-VERSUS-RESTING-BOOK DIVERGENCE IS NULL AS A SIGN RULE. l1_book.quote_bid_share is served, never masked, and is explicitly 'resting-liquidity lean, distinct from aggressor flow' - the obvious blind-available absorption detector. Rule 'D-1 positive flow with quote_bid_share < 0.50 -> day down' fires 9 times across G21-G23 and hits 4 (misses: G21 0609 +70, G21 0616 +970, G21 0618 +520, G22 0626 +230, G23 0717 +180; hits: G22 0625, G23 0710, G23 0715, G23 0716). Diagnosed cause, which matters more than the result: the session-mean field spans only 0.475-0.512 across every session in three groups while its own served intraday p25_p75 is [0.333, 0.667]. The aggregation destroys the signal. If the resting-book lean is to be usable it must be served at phase resolution or as a dispersion statistic, not as a session mean.
(4b) NO FORWARD-CDD-SLOPE RESCUE OF THE BURN GATE. Screened over the 20 staged days of G22+G23 (a SCREEN, not a conclusion; half the rows are grafted and fenced): rank correlation against day-move is -0.033 for the h6-h0 ladder slope, -0.017 for the h0 level, +0.066 for run_delta_cdd, and -0.186 for burn. All null; the burn one is null with the wrong sign.

(5) MEASUREMENT REQUEST, not a mechanism: the render-day is scored 20:00-to-20:00 while the state's own _information_clock declares the session closing at 17:00, so every non-Friday scored day carries the first two hours of the NEXT exchange session. Measured g20-g23: exactly 0 on 8 of 8 Fridays; on the 32 non-Friday sessions 21 negative / 9 positive / 2 zero, median -30, sum -1,420; largest single instance -230 on G23 0715, the only sign flip in 40 sessions. Below about 50 USD this is noise and nobody needs to model it. It should still be RECONCILED once at the harness level rather than re-derived by each specialist, because a specialist reasoning to the 17:00 close is being scored on a different object and only finds out when the tail is large.
